title: Co-op voice for all adventures: vox.bin, vox-igc.bin, vox-mp.bin, net.bin (u3fix.exe coop-voice2, coop-voice2/apply_coop_vox.cpp)
notes: Since 2026-11-13 C++ (u3fix.exe coop-voice2 = apply_coop_vox.py). On the reference vox.bin (which dc-recipes rebuilds) the step is a byte-exact no-op; from the retail vox.bin it adds the same 464 entries to the same size, the reference differing only in 42 bytes of old entries that an earlier session edited. Since 1.32.2 the needed lines are every aligned word of an ss-coop-adv script that is a vox entry id, not only the five words after a say call (a wait-say's third alternative line sits one word further): 17 co-op lines (airport 4, dig 7, fort 3, london 1, monastery 1, syria 1; vox.bin 1115 -> 1132 entries, 145767 -> 149309 bytes) were missing from vox.bin and never played ("Vox ... did not play"). reference_check off: the reference manifest has the vox.bin without them.
